stories.title: External Link Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the response schema for external provider research links including fields for source (Healthgrades, NPI, state board), URL, validation_status, and guidance_text. Establish contract for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Core Link Generation Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to construct external research URLs for Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards using provider identifiers (e.g., NPI, state). Include guidance text generation per source.

stories.title: URL Validation and Safety Integration
stories.description: Integrate URL Guardian to validate generated links (HEAD check, AI verification, correction) and ensure safe, reachable URLs before returning them.

stories.title: Facade/API Exposure for External Links
stories.description: Expose validated external research links through Evaluate Care facade for use in provider detail responses and chat outputs.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Link Generation
stories.description: Create tests covering URL construction accuracy, validation outcomes, fallback behavior for unsupported states, and correct guidance text inclusion.
